name: What are common signs of poorly done wall framing that I should look out for?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of poorly done wall framing that I should look out for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of poorly done wall framing can include uneven walls that are visibly bowed or not plumb (vertically straight), doors and windows that stick or don't close properly, and floors that feel bouncy or noticeably unlevel. Cracks in drywall, especially around door and window frames, can also indicate underlying framing issues. In more severe cases, you might notice sagging ceilings or roofs. These issues compromise structural integrity, can lead to long-term problems, and might impact the safety and value of your home. Addressing them early is crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for uneven walls, sticking doors/windows, bouncy floors, or cracks in drywall around openings. These can indicate poorly done wall framing.
